name: Only Worshipping God
overview: Scripture clearly commands exclusive worship of the one true God, emphasizing that He alone is worthy of our praise and devotion. God declares His jealousy for His worship, forbidding the honoring of any other gods or idols (Exodus 34:14; Isaiah 42:8). Jesus affirms this truth by resisting Satan’s temptation with the command to worship and serve only the Lord God (Matthew 4:10; Luke 4:8). True worship, as Jesus teaches, is offered to the Father in spirit and truth, reflecting a heartfelt and sincere devotion that God seeks from His people (John 4:23).
